mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by > 200,000 in a month, the strong labor market boosts economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by > 2% in a quarter signals reduced supply chain pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as input costs decrease.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate exceeds 3% annually and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) remains below 250, the balanced growth signals sustained economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.06 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% in < 6 months) signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 7% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) decreases by > 100,000 in a month, the weak labor market signals economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by > 5% annually signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as retailers benefit.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).
